description: Alldigi Tech Limited, a business process and HR technology company, provides business process solutions in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Business Process Management (BPM) and Technology & Digital (T&D). The company offers customer services, customer acquisition, technical support, AML/KYC compliance, background verification, finance and accounting, healthcare support, title and mortgage, collection services, insurance services, SmartPay-payroll outsourcing, SmartHR-HRMS for enterprises, and multi-country payroll solutions. It serves technology, banking and fintech, healthcare, insurance, automotive and manufacturing, telecom, media and entertainment, FMCG, consulting, and IT and ITES industries. The company was formerly known as Allsec Technologies Limited and changed its name to Alldigi Tech Limitedin September 2024. Alldigi Tech Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Chennai, India. Alldigi Tech Limited is a subsidiary of Digitide Solutions Limited.
